exercises.name: Ball Slams

source_english.description: Ball Slams raise a medicine ball overhead and drive it into the floor using the hips, trunk, and arms together.
instructions: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart and hold the medicine ball overhead with both hands.
Brace your trunk and bend the hips and knees slightly.
Drive the ball forcefully into the floor in front of you.
Retrieve it with a squat or hinge and reset before the next repetition.
form_cues: Keep the ball in front of you.
Use the hips and trunk together.
common_mistakes: Catching a rebound with locked knees.
source_english.safety_note: Use a slam-rated medicine ball and keep the rebound area clear.

exercises.name: Battle Ropes

source_english.description: Battle Ropes create alternating waves from a stable athletic stance, with the rope motion traveling toward its anchor.
instructions: Stand with a soft bend in the knees and hold one rope end in each hand.
Brace your trunk and create alternating waves by lifting and lowering the hands.
Keep the waves traveling toward the anchor rather than swinging the torso.
Work for the planned interval, then lower the ropes under control.
form_cues: Match the wave to your breathing.
common_mistakes: Leaning back against the rope tension.
source_english.safety_note: Secure the rope anchor and keep both feet planted during waves.
